title.en: What Would Your Pocket Map Remember?
title.zh: 你的口袋小地图，会记住什么？

description.en: Sketch an invented place through six choices about landmarks, personal stops and playful omissions. Discover your map’s particular purpose.
description.zh: 用地标、个人停点与趣味省略六个选择，画虚构地点，看小地图的独特用途。

introduction.en: This is a creative map of an invented place, not directions for a real journey or a test of orientation. Decide what to include and what to leave out; a small map can have a limited purpose.
introduction.zh: 这是虚构地点的创意地图，不是真出行指引，也不考方向感。选画什么、省什么；小图可以只做一件事。

focus.en: Recording the structure of an imagined place, the stops that matter to a character or discoveries left for a future reader.
focus.zh: 画一张虚构地点的小地图：可以标清地标，也可以留下角色停过的地方，或留一块空白请下一个人来画。

prompt.en: The first mark on your pocket map is…

label.en: A recognizable central shape with the paths around it.
A small place where the fictional traveler would linger.
label.zh: 虚构旅人会多待的一小处。

label.en: An unfilled corner labeled “something to notice here.”
label.zh: 空角写“这里还有可发现的”。

prompt.en: The map is getting crowded. You keep…

label.en: The few stops that explain this character’s visit.
label.zh: 能说明角色此行的几个停点。

label.en: Enough blank space for a reader’s own discovery.
label.zh: 给读者发现留的足够空白。

label.en: The main shapes needed to understand the invented layout.
label.zh: 理解虚构布局所需主形。

prompt.en: You add one annotation. It says…

label.en: Leave this little square available for a new detail.
This shape connects the two illustrated districts.
The character paused here to finish a tiny sketch.
label.zh: 角色在此停下画完小速写。

prompt.en: Two routes reach the same drawn place. You show…
prompt.zh: 两路到同一画中地点，你展示……

label.en: How each route relates to the central landmark.
label.zh: 两路分别怎样靠中央地标。

label.en: The different little stops along each route.
One complete route and room to invent an alternative.
label.zh: 一条完整路，留空间另编。

prompt.en: Another reader redraws the fictional map. You hope…
prompt.zh: 另一读者重画此虚构图，你希望……

label.en: They choose their own meaningful stops.
label.zh: 他们选自己的有意思停点。

label.en: The basic relationships between places remain readable.
They add something that my version left open.
label.zh: 他们添我版留开放的东西。

label.en: The room still available for discoveries.
One character’s small visit to this place.
The recognizable shape of an invented neighborhood.

summary.en: Your pocket map keeps the imagined place understandable. A few stable shapes give the reader reference points without pretending that a small sketch contains every detail of the world.
summary.zh: 你的口袋地图，让人看得懂这个想象中的地方。几个清楚的地标就能帮助定位，不需要把整个世界的细节都塞进一张小图。

example.en: A square tower between two drawn lanes might let a reader understand where the paper market sits relative to the river.
example.zh: 在两条画出来的小巷之间标一座方塔，就能让读者看懂纸市集与河流的相对位置。

strength.en: Clear reference points help an invented setting remain coherent as the story moves, leaving other details free to change or remain unspecified.
strength.zh: 有了明确的参照，故事走到不同地方时，场景仍然连贯。其他细节可以变化，也可以暂时不画。

tradeoff.en: A map can be clear but impersonal if it only shows structure. One chosen small detail can give the drawing character without confusing its layout.
tradeoff.zh: 只标结构，地图虽然清楚，也可能少一点特色。添一个小细节，就能让它更有自己的样子，又不打乱布局。

experiment.en: Draw three fictional landmarks and two connecting paths. Explain their relationships in one sentence before adding decorations or invented street names.
experiment.zh: 画三个虚构地标，再用两条路连起来。先用一句话说明它们的位置关系，再添装饰或自创街名。

summary.en: Your map records a particular visit rather than the whole place. A stop earns its mark through what a fictional character did there, not through official importance or popularity.
summary.zh: 你的地图记录一次特别的到访，而不是整个地方。某处值得标出来，是因为角色在那里做过一件事，不一定因为它出名或重要。

example.en: A tiny mark by a made-up bridge might note where the traveler sat to finish drawing the shape of a passing cloud.
example.zh: 在一座虚构小桥旁做个记号，写下旅人曾坐在这里，画完一朵飘过的云。

strength.en: A selected stop can turn a plain layout into a small narrative and let a reader see how one character actually used the setting.
strength.zh: 选几个停留的地方，普通平面图就有了故事。读者也能看见，角色怎样走过这个场景。

tradeoff.en: Your chosen stops will not be another reader’s chosen stops. Keeping the map explicitly personal avoids presenting one route as the best experience.
tradeoff.zh: 你想停的地方，不一定是别人想停的地方。说明这是一张个人路线图，就不必把它说成最好的游览方式。

experiment.en: Invent a character’s twenty-minute visit and mark only three stops. Give each a plain action rather than a rating or claim of hidden significance.
experiment.zh: 想象一个角色用了二十分钟到访这里，只标三个停留处。每处写一个普通动作，不评分，也不必赋予隐藏意义。

summary.en: Your map invites another version by leaving selected space open. An omission is part of the creative invitation, not a trap, a missing safety instruction or a test of imagination.
summary.zh: 你的地图留出一块空白，邀请下一个人画出另一个版本。这是创作上的留白，不是陷阱，也不是实际出行时缺失的安全指引，更不考想象力。

example.en: A blank square beside an invented square might ask the next reader to add a small shop, a bench or something entirely different.
example.zh: 在虚构广场旁留一个空格，请下一个读者添一家小店、一张长椅，或别的任何东西。

strength.en: An intentional gap gives another person a concrete way to contribute and lets the fictional place grow without treating the first drawing as final.
strength.zh: 留一处明确的空白，别人就有了具体的参与方式。这个虚构地方也能继续变化，不必把第一张图当成定稿。

tradeoff.en: Too many gaps can make an invitation vague. A little established structure gives the next reader something useful to respond to.
tradeoff.zh: 空白太多，别人可能不知道从哪里画起。先留下少量明确的结构，会更容易接着创作。

experiment.en: Draw a small invented neighborhood with one clearly marked blank plot. Offer two possible additions while explicitly leaving room for a third idea.
experiment.zh: 画一个虚构的小街区，清楚标出一块空地。你可以给出两种添画的想法，也明确欢迎第三种。

description.en: Sketch an invented place with landmarks, personal stops or a space for discovery. Six choices reveal what your little map remembers and what it leaves open for another reader.
description.zh: 用地标、个人停点或发现空白，画虚构地点。六次选择，看小地图记什么，也给后来读者留什么。

question.en: Why leave an intentional gap in a fictional map?
question.zh: 为什么要在虚构地图里刻意留空？

answer.en: A gap can invite a later contribution when enough of the place is already clear. Landmarks make the layout readable, while personal stops record one visit. This is a creative map, not incomplete directions for a real journey.
answer.zh: 已有足够清楚结构时，空白可邀请后来贡献。地标让布局可读，个人停点记录一次到访。这是创意地图，不是缺指引的真实出行路线。
